title: Avengers
subtitle: Recommended starting points & key stories
intro: Team highlights across classic and modern eras. Bendis and Busiek offer accessible beginnings; Hickman is a longer connected project. Team membership changes, so this is not one fixed roster.

stories.title: Under Siege
stories.why: A defining siege of Avengers Mansion.
stories.match: The Under Siege Epic covers #264–277, including the core siege.

stories.title: Busiek & Pérez: Heroes Return
stories.why: A useful bridge into classic team dynamics with a fresh launch.
stories.match: Avengers Assemble Vol. 1 is the Busiek/Pérez collection, not the animated Marvel Universe Avengers Assemble series.

stories.title: Avengers Forever
stories.why: A time-travel celebration of Avengers history; save until the team feels familiar.
stories.match: This is the 1998 Busiek/Pacheco series, not Jason Aaron’s later Avengers Forever.

stories.title: Ultron Unlimited
stories.why: An acclaimed Busiek/Pérez confrontation with Ultron.
stories.match: Avengers Assemble Vol. 2 covers #12–23 and #0; the core Ultron story is inside.

stories.title: New Avengers: Breakout
stories.why: Bendis launches a new team with a very different mix of heroes.
stories.match: Choose this six-issue Breakout volume to begin; Complete Collection Vol. 1 overlaps it.

stories.title: Hickman: Avengers World / Everything Dies
stories.why: Two parallel series begin a larger saga. Read both before moving toward Infinity and Time Runs Out.
stories.match: These are complementary books, not alternate editions: Avengers World starts Avengers; Everything Dies starts New Avengers.
